children: Privy has launched a prebuilt stablecoin card component that can be embedded into applications with a single integration. According to Odaily, the service is available in more than 25 issuing markets and is planned to expand to more than 100 by year-end. Users can spend directly from a Privy wallet or DeFi vault balance without first moving funds into a separate card account. Lead Bank is the issuer, Bridge manages the project, and Stripe provides issuance services.

title: Privy Launches Stablecoin Card Prebuilt Component With Stripe Partnership
